if [ "${INSTALL_FFMPEG:-true}" = "true" ]; then

fi

apt-get clean
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RAW_BASE="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/${REPO_OWNER}/${REPO_NAME}/${BRANCH}"

curl -L --fail --retry 3 --max-time 600 -o "./lang.yml" "${RAW_BASE}/lang.yml"

if [ "${INSTALL_YTDLP:-true}" = "true" ]; then
  curl -L --fail --retry 3 -o ./yt-dlp https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/yt-dlp
